verdict.rationale: Poly documents tag support that syncs bidirectionally with Finder tags and colors, and search/retrieval features (natural language, visual similarity), but there is no evidence of 'typed properties' (structured metadata fields/schemas) or of consistent, structured tag-based retrieval workflows beyond basic color/tag sync. missing for 10: typed/structured property fields, evidence of consistent tag-based filtering or retrieval UI, cross-file property schemas.
